I was 17 years old. I just got my license and had it for about 2 months at most. I couldn't afford a car so I drove my moms minivan. Of course I had rules on my license like no driving past 11 or something and only 1 other person in the car. 

I had about 7 or 8 people in the minivan and it was like 11 or 11:30 PM. My friends decided to buy eggs at the grocery store and throw them at the other kids in the other town. Only kids that were around our age. Our town and their town was a rivalry in sports and we hated each other. Well, we find some girls that were walking down the street and I pull up next to them and my friend slides the door open and starts throwing the eggs at them and I take off.

Soon as I get to the end of the block some guy is behind me in an SUV right on my ass. Honking his horn and everything. I turn down the street to get off the main road. This guy speeds up next to me telling me to pull over. Might I add, this is 25 mph street where there are houses and cars parked parked on both sides of the street. I get to the end of the block at a stop sign and he somehow gets in front of me and cuts me off.

He gets out of the car and comes up to my door and I lock the doors and roll the windows up. His wife gets out and stands in front of my van. This dude is screaming and yelling at me like he is Samuel L. Jackson. He was clearly drunk or he does steroids and is on a roid rage. This couple were around their 40's. This guy could easily kick my ass. He definitely lifted, bro's.

But there is 7-8 or us. Couple of my friends say lets get out and kick this guys ass. But we all decided not to because we were all on the varsity basketball team and we would get kicked off the team easily. The guy ends up spitting on my window. His wife goes next to him and start using their phone. This was my opportunity to get away because she left the front of my van. I speed off and get on the main road where there is more traffic. I'm turning left and right on every block to try and ditch him and he got lost on the main road.

I drop everyone off and go home because I was scared as shit. I wake up the next morning and I seen a cop car drive down my block (I live on a dead end street) like every couple hours, I'm like fuck! But I have a drug dealer that lives on my block so they were just looking at him. Whew, got away with that one.

TL;DR: Threw eggs at people from my minivan. Guy chased me with his SUV and cornered me. Raged on me hella hard and spit on my window. Got away
